name: context-handoff
description: When the context window passes a set percent, Claude writes a handoff file and a fresh session on the same model continues from it.

thresholdPercent.title: Threshold (%)
thresholdPercent.description: Context window fill at which context-handoff gets involved. Keep it below the auto-compact point, or compaction happens first.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: finish-turn: let the running turn finish, then write the handoff. stop-now: abort the running turn at the threshold and write the handoff at once. notify-only: only tell you and Claude that the context is filling.

handoffDir.title: Handoff folder
handoffDir.description: Where handoff files are written. Empty means ~/.claude/handoffs.

permissionMode.title: Permission mode of the new session
permissionMode.description: Passed to the new session as --permission-mode.

sameModel.title: Same model
sameModel.description: Start the new session on the model this session uses (--model).

autoLaunch.title: Launch the new session
autoLaunch.description: Start the new session automatically (Windows). Off, or on macOS and Linux, you get the command to run yourself.
